subject: Human Body
title: Brain Energy Demands
description: A 60-second lesson on Brain Energy Demands.

hook.text: Your brain weighs 3 pounds but uses 20% of your body's energy. It's the most expensive organ to run.

buildup.text: Neurons run on glucose almost exclusively. A drop in blood sugar causes confusion, dizziness, and fainting.

discovery.text: The brain can't store energy. It needs constant blood flow. Five minutes without oxygen causes permanent damage.

twist.text: During fasting, the brain switches to ketones as backup fuel. This metabolic flexibility takes days to activate.

climax.text: Thinking hard doesn't burn significantly more calories. The brain's baseline maintenance, not thought, uses most energy.

punchline.text: 3 pounds. 20% of your energy. Always running. Never off.

quiz.question: What happens after 5 minutes without oxygen to the brain?
options: The brain enters a temporary sleep state
The brain switches to anaerobic energy
